newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips strong but off highs, Nasdaq eases.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips strong but off highs, Nasdaq eases.

text.p: The Dow industrial average stayed firm but came off highs in afternoon trading on Tuesday, as investors looked to buy high-quality blue chip names. But a weak technology sector depressed Nasdaq.
The Dow was up around 30 points at 7319. Just after midday, it rose 50 points to around 7340, causing the New York Stock Exchange to put curbs on index-arbitrage trading.
Nasdaq, comprised of many technology shares, sagged. It was off around 15 points to 1390.
Tech stocks were hurt after negative earnings news from Seagate Technology Inc and Cabletron Systems.
